summary: Backend-only infra fix verification. All 4 fixes verified where locally testable. Pytest suite for G19 crash-only loop-trip fix passes 15/15 including the 2 new regression tests (test_deploy_restarts_never_trip_loop, test_mixed_deploy_and_crash_boots_only_count_crashes). Backend boots cleanly with the new ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=48) default executor — no import errors, 'Application startup complete' observed, and 8 concurrent /api/healthz requests all returned 200 (300-400ms). All 8 workflow YAML files parse cleanly with yaml.safe_load; node-version successfully bumped to 22 at all 12 occurrences across 6 workflows (rebaseline-visual.yml correctly untouched — no node-version pin). .dockerignore carve-outs use the correct `dir/*` + `!dir/specific-file` negation idiom for docs/a11y_baseline.json, docs/a11y_journey_baseline.json, and .emergent/latest-qa-report.md. auto-qa.yml's new 'Commit report back to repo' step shell logic is correct (file-exists guard → git config → git add → diff --cached --quiet no-op guard → commit → push with GITHUB_REF stripping). FIX 3 (node bump) and the auto-qa commit-back step cannot be end-to-end confirmed without an actual push to GitHub — flagged as expected.
action_items: Push to GitHub to confirm FIX 3 (node 22 CI jobs) run green — cannot be verified from sandbox.
Push to GitHub to confirm FIX 4 (auto-qa commit-back step) actually commits .emergent/latest-qa-report.md and admin QA dashboard's 'Auto-QA report' card starts showing real data.
critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1 (process_recovery.py): crash-only filter in record_boot's loop-trip check AND resolve_if_stable's auto-resolve check both correctly mirror the pre-existing crash_only pattern in recovery_status(). Tests are meaningful, not tautological (they exercise real record_boot() with FakeDB, mixed reasons, positive+negative paths).

FIX 2 (main.py): set_default_executor via asyncio.get_event_loop() works but note that asyncio.get_event_loop() is deprecated in Python 3.12+ when no running loop exists. Currently invoked inside lifespan() where a loop IS running, so this is fine, but consider asyncio.get_running_loop() for future-proofing.

FIX 4 (auto-qa.yml): commit-back step correctly gated on github.event_name == 'push' (avoids double-committing on scheduled runs). GITHUB_TOKEN pushes don't retrigger push workflows so there's no CI loop risk — matches the pattern used elsewhere.

.dockerignore: negation carve-outs are correctly ordered AFTER their broader excludes (docs/* on line 91, then !docs/... on lines 102-103; .emergent/* on line 17, then !.emergent/latest-qa-report.md on line 24) — required for Docker to honor negations.

rca_of_the_issue: All 4 root causes as described in the review request are consistent with the code changes observed and behave correctly under test: (1) crash-only filter applied to both loop-detection and auto-resolve; (2) larger asyncio default executor set inside lifespan startup; (3) node-version 20→22 across all 12 CI job pins; (4) .dockerignore carve-outs + new commit-back step for the Auto-QA report.
